claims.evidence: The witness describes a matte finish with rounded corners, which is the physical profile of the Slim model.
The witness did not see the console powered on or the storage menu.
Photo 0 shows one black game controller resting on the console.
While the exterior is described, internal dust buildup and port condition were not verified.

risks.proof: A photo of the 'Settings > Storage' screen.
A video showing a disc being inserted, recognized, and ejected.
risks.if_unproven: as a digital-only console with a broken drive.

risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into the PlayStation Network.

risks.risk: Controller analog stick drift or button failure
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus or play a game.
risks.if_unproven: as a faulty controller requiring replacement.

risks.proof: Verification that games are not tied to a temporary subscription or a different primary account.
risks.if_unproven: as having zero games (digital games have no resale value if the account is not transferred).

proof_requests: Photo of the 'Settings > Storage' menu to confirm HDD size.
Video of the console running a game to check for fan noise and overheating.
Video of a disc being read by the drive.
Photo of the back ports to check for damage or tampering seals.
response.reason: The item is confirmed as a PS4 Slim. It can be priced based on the worst-case scenario of a 500GB model with a broken disc drive and no usable games.
